outcome.description: After a seven-day bench trial the district court dismissed McCarthy's lien-foreclosure and contract claims and awarded Stark $51,760.83 on his breach-of-contract counterclaim (completion cost of $202,090.81 less $150,329.98 unpaid contract balance) plus $34,100.46 in ICPA damages (total $85,861.29), and $129,434 in attorney fees and $4,535.33 costs. The Idaho Supreme Court affirmed in full and awarded Stark fees on appeal.

source.caseName: McCarthy Corporation v. Stark Investment Group, LLC, Craig Stark, and U.S. Bank, N.A.
source.court: Idaho Supreme Court, on appeal from the District Court of the First Judicial District, Kootenai County
source.excerptNote: documentText is verbatim from Part I (Factual Background, and the Procedural History through the statement that the case proceeded to a seven-day bench trial), plus the trial evidence on Stark's lender-related costs and the banker's testimony, which the opinion recites inside the discussion of the ICPA award. Removed: the opening summary of the bench-trial result, the trial court's findings on breach, completion-cost damages, lien, slander of title and ICPA liability, the ICPA damages total, the fee award, and all appellate analysis. Whitespace and page-number artifacts normalized; the bid-item and invoice-summary tables (and the sentences introducing them) are omitted.
